description: This is a PHP unit test class for the Sphere model in the Goteo project. It contains various tests to verify the creation, validation, icon handling, SDG relationships, deletion, and cleanup of Sphere objects.

classes.name: SphereTest
classes.description: A PHP unit test class for testing the Sphere model's functionality within the Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of Sphere object and verifies its class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Checks validation and save behavior of a Sphere instance.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a Sphere object, validates, saves, and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testIcon
methods.description: Verifies icon retrieval, setting, and URL correctness for Sphere objects.

methods.name: testSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, retrieving, and replacing SDG relationships for Sphere objects.

methods.name: testRemoveSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests removal of SDG relationships from Sphere objects.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes a Sphere object from the database.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving a Sphere object that has been deleted.
